1 second after stowing #element:
<title Refills [G_refill] /> 10%|10%|15% of the Stowed Weapon's Magazine with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

2.5|2 second delay between further Refills with 1|2+ Mods equipped.

Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers and Rocket Launchers.

var element = <arc/>Arc Weapons

After stowing #element:
Begins to <title refill [G_refill] /> 10%|10%|15% of the Stowed Weapon's Magazine from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers and Rocket Launchers.

var element = <arc/>Arc Weapons

After stowing #element:
Begins to <title refill [G_refill] /> 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers and Rocket Launchers.

var element = <arc/>Arc Weapons

After stowing #element:
Begins to <title refill [G_refill] /> 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.
